_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the site's core PL head-term in titles/meta/H1 for the homepage and generator hub pages — it is already the primary target and is natural, not stiff.
phrases.good_example: Ładne Czcionki i Stylowy Tekst do Skopiowania — Literki na Insta, TikToka i Nicki (locales/pl.json meta.title)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not stuff into platform-specific pages that already own a narrower head term (e.g. czcionki-na-instagram should lead with its own platform phrase, not duplicate the homepage title).

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for library/symbol-collection pages aimed at nickname decoration (Discord, Roblox symbol libraries).
phrases.good_example: Symbole Discord — kopiuj i wklej znaki do nazw kanałów i profili (pl/library/symbole-discord/index.html title)
phrases.avoid_when: Not the right term for single-glyph identity pages (symbol/) — there the item's own name is the primary term.

phrases.english_concept: decorative marks/badges for a nickname (diminutive/community variant)
phrases.usage_guidance: A candidate secondary/long-tail variant for a nickname-symbols page's title or an H2 — do not replace the site's existing primary term (PL-002) with it; use as a supporting synonym once evidence is stronger.
phrases.good_example: "Znaczki ozdobne do nicku" — recurring thread/page title across multiple PL gaming/community sites (cshacked.pl forum tutorials, bielsko.info editorial)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use in formal/editorial copy (symbol/ identity pages, guide/ authority pages) — it reads as gaming-forum-casual.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary term for the site's own invisible-character tool page; keep as the umbrella term and use PL-005 (niewidzialny nick) as the gaming-specific long-tail variant within FAQ/intro copy.
phrases.good_example: Niewidzialny Znak (Niewidzialny Tekst) — Kopiuj i Wklej Pustą Spację (pl/niewidzialny-znak/index.html title)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this is the site's own umbrella term, safe everywhere on the page it already lives on.

phrases.usage_guidance: Add as an explicit FAQ question/answer or intro-copy synonym on pl/niewidzialny-znak/ — the page currently only says 'niewidzialny znak/tekst/nazwa' and never the word gamers actually type ('nick'). High-confidence gap: this is the dominant real-world search phrasing for exactly this page's job.
phrases.good_example: "csgo niewidzialny nick na steamie dzieki temu w nawiasie XD: (ㅤ)" — viral wykop.pl wpis (2015); "Jak zrobić niewidzialny nick steam?" — mpcforum.pl thread title; "Niewidzialny nick w Steam i CS2: jak go ustawić i się wyróżnić" — profilerr.net article title
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use for non-gaming contexts (Instagram bio blank line, WhatsApp blank message) — there 'niewidzialny znak/tekst' is the correct generic term, not 'nick'.

phrases.usage_guidance: Safe as an occasional informal synonym for 'nick'/'nazwa' in FAQ/intro copy on usecase and generator pages — already used this way once on-site.
phrases.good_example: "Najprostszy sposób to imię lub ksywka w środku i ozdobniki po bokach, na przykład ✦ Zosia ✦" (pl/ozdobniki/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid in formal/technical copy (symbol/ codepoint pages, guide/ platform-rules explainers) where 'nazwa' or 'nick' reads more neutral.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use when explaining Discord's own field naming ('zmień pseudonim na tym serwerze') — matches Discord's actual PL client wording, so it is the technically correct term there, not just a style choice.
phrases.good_example: "kliknij prawym przyciskiem na serwerze i zmień pseudonim na tym serwerze" (pl/czcionki-discord/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — safe standard term, already used correctly.

phrases.usage_guidance: Critical distinction to keep explicit on every Roblox/Discord name page: styled Unicode goes in 'nazwa wyświetlana', never in '@nazwa użytkownika' (PL-010). Already handled correctly and repeatedly site-wide.
phrases.good_example: "Tak, ale tylko w nazwie wyświetlanej (display name) — czyli tej, którą widzą inni gracze w grze" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Always pair with PL-009 when explaining why a styled name 'didn't save' — the site already does this correctly and it is the single most common troubleshooting question across platform pages.
phrases.good_example: "@Nazwa użytkownika (do logowania) przyjmuje wyłącznie litery, cyfry i jedno podkreślenie, bez żadnych symboli" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Keep as the site's primary umbrella term for its own decoration-picker feature; it is natural (not a forced coinage — 'ozdobnik' is a real, generic Polish word for a decorative element) and already load-bearing across the UI tab labels.
phrases.good_example: Ozdobniki do Skopiowania ✦ Symbole do Nicku (kopiuj i wklej) (pl/ozdobniki/index.html title)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for any UI/copy referring to wraparound name-decoration symbols; already a tab label and section heading on-site.
phrases.good_example: "Ramki i symbole do nicku" (pl/ozdobniki/index.html H3); decoration tab label in locales/pl.json ('frames': 'Ramki')
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Already correct on the Roblox names page section; the same term applies 1:1 to CS:GO/CS2 clan tags if the site ever expands gaming-name content to that game.
phrases.good_example: "Krótkie Nazwy i Tag Klanu" — "Krótkie, łatwe do zapamiętania, mieszczą się w nazwie wyświetlanej i na czacie klanu" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Use when describing pre-authored name examples on any gaming-name page; matches the CLAUDE.md 'Ready-Made Names' pattern already used in EN.
phrases.good_example: "Gotowe listy nazw — zadziorne, słodkie i na tag klanu" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html meta description); H2 "Gotowe Fajne Nazwy do Robloxa (Kliknij, by Skopiować)"
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: The site's single most-repeated troubleshooting term (appears on 15+ pages) — keep using it exactly as-is; it is the correct, natural word and matches how PL users describe this exact symptom.
phrases.good_example: "Dlaczego niektóre ozdobniki pokazują się jako kwadraciki? Kwadracik (□) pojawia się, gdy telefon lub przeglądarka osoby oglądającej nie ma czcionki, która rysuje dany znak." (pl/ozdobniki/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not conflate with krzaczki (PL-016) — kwadracik is a missing-glyph fallback box, krzaczki is garbled/wrong-encoding text. Keep the distinction when writing new troubleshooting copy.

phrases.english_concept: garbled/mojibake text (wrong-encoding characters, not missing glyphs)
phrases.usage_guidance: Candidate to add as a distinct FAQ item on niewidzialny-znak/ozdobniki/estetyczne-czcionki pages, explicitly distinguishing it from kwadraciki: krzaczki = wrong encoding (rare from this site's own Unicode output, but a real thing users search for when copy-pasted text looks wrong elsewhere), kwadraciki = missing glyph. Do not merge the two explanations.
phrases.good_example: "Pojawiły mi się dziwne znaki zamiast polskich liter, jak się tego pozbyć" — wykop.pl wpis (2013); confirmed as standard PL tech-forum term across wykop.pl, elektroda.pl, 4programmers.net, pcformat.pl forum threads
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use interchangeably with kwadracik/kwadraciki (PL-015) — they describe different failure modes and a merged explanation would be inaccurate.

phrases.usage_guidance: Keep as the standard, warm way to explain the diacritic-coverage limitation across every style-generator FAQ — it's genuinely how Poles refer to this (the 'tails'/'hooks' under/over letters), not a site invention.
phrases.good_example: "możesz zapisać je bez ogonków i kresek (np. „pieknie” zamiast „pięknie”)" (pl/estetyczne-czcionki/index.html FAQ); also used in pl/usecase/czcionki-tatuaze/index.html: "przetestuj też wersję bez ogonków, np. «milosc»"
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Keep using specifically in impersonation/moderation-risk explanations (Discord name-safety guide) — do not use it for ordinary decorative-symbol content, where it would wrongly imply risk.
phrases.good_example: "użycie znaków-podróbek, by blisko naśladować innego prawdziwego użytkownika, członka administracji albo zweryfikowaną markę" (pl/guide/bezpieczna-nazwa-na-discordzie/index.html FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: Do not apply to normal stylized fonts/ozdobniki — this term is specifically about deceptive lookalike use, and using it near unrelated decoration content would wrongly scare users.

phrases.usage_guidance: Correct, standard term for the ban-risk explanation on Discord name-safety content — no change needed.
phrases.good_example: "To problem podszywania się, nie stylu" (pl/guide/bezpieczna-nazwa-na-discordzie/index.html)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Correct as-is for explaining the autocomplete/mention-matching failure mode of decorated names.
phrases.good_example: "Dlaczego nikt nie może mnie @oznaczyć, choć moja nazwa wygląda normalnie?" (pl/guide/bezpieczna-nazwa-na-discordzie/index.html FAQ question)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Already the correct, natural term for the site's character-counter tool; no change needed.
phrases.good_example: "sprawdzian limitów dla 26 platform" (pl/licznik-slow-i-znakow/index.html meta description)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Core, ubiquitous CTA phrasing — already used correctly and consistently across nearly every page (title tags, button labels, instructions). Do not vary it without reason.
phrases.good_example: "Kliknij symbol, aby od razu go skopiować" and title-tag "kopiuj i wklej" pattern used across all library/ pages
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this is appropriately high-frequency, not overused, since each page independently needs its own copy CTA.

phrases.usage_guidance: Preferred default over the borrowed 'vibe' (PL-024) for most copy — it reads native rather than youth-slang-borrowed, so it's safer for a broader audience while still capturing the same idea.
phrases.good_example: "100+ gotowych zestawów emoji, które nadają Twojemu bio, statusowi i opisom jeden klimat" (pl/kombinacje-emoji/index.html hero tagline)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Fine in casual/example copy (e.g. showing 'Good vibes only' as a sample phrase) or informal teaser text — do not use in headings/titles or formal guide copy, where 'klimat' (PL-023) is the safer default.
phrases.good_example: "Zwykły tekst: Good vibes only ← Kaligrafia Unicode: 𝒢𝑜𝑜𝒹 𝓋𝒾𝒷𝑒𝓈" (pl/czcionki-na-snapchat/index.html example); "literki, które grają z twoim vibe'em" (locales/pl.json guides.items.1.description)
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid in symbol/ identity pages, guide/ authority content, or any legal/technical FAQ — register mismatch.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary hub term, already correctly used site-wide including as the H1/title of the dedicated hub page — keep as the anchor term for this whole content family.
phrases.good_example: Estetyczne Czcionki Generator — ａｅｓｔｈｅｔｉｃ tekst do skopiowania (pl/estetyczne-czcionki/index.html title)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Good phrase to extend to gaming-name pages too — forum evidence confirms the same underlying concern (over-decorated names read as chaotic/hard to read) independent of the site's own copy.
phrases.good_example: "Polecam zacząć od jednego stylu i dorzucić jeden ozdobnik — nie wszystko naraz" and "tylko nie przesadzaj — całe CV w gotyku nie wygląda profesjonalnie" (locales/pl.json FAQ)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Already used naturally and repeatedly as the 'why' hook across meta descriptions and headings; keep it as the go-to motivational verb.
phrases.good_example: "kopiuj i wklej znaki do nazw kanałów i profili" pages consistently frame value as helping profiles "wyróżnić się"; "Symbole Roblox — sprawdzone pod kątem aktualnego filtru nazw" section context (pl/library/symbole-roblox/index.html)

phrases.good_example: "Gotowe listy nazw — zadziorne, słodkie i na tag klanu" (pl/usecase/nazwy-do-robloxa/index.html meta description)

phrases.english_concept: lettering as a tattoo discipline/style category
phrases.register: studio-professional; recognised but not spontaneously produced by casual customers
phrases.usage_guidance: Use when naming the discipline/style family, exactly as a Polish studio would. Keep 'czcionki do tatuażu' (P24) and 'napis' (P23) as the consumer/search-side words — 'liternictwo' is a credibility signal, not a search term.
phrases.good_example: Tatuażysta dopasuje liternictwo do twojej skóry: grubość kresek, połączenia między literami.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 'liternictwo' as a title/H1 or a search target — a customer looking for a tattoo font types 'czcionki do tatuażu', not 'liternictwo'. Do not use it to mean a single font.

phrases.english_concept: the check/tick mark ✓ — everyday Polish name (street name, not the typographic one)
phrases.register: neutral-colloquial; 'fajka' and 'ptaszek' are both usable in ordinary writing, 'parafka' is office/bureaucratic
phrases.usage_guidance: On a Polish ✓ symbol page, put the formal name first in the H1 and the street name in parentheses — 'Znak zaznaczenia ✓ (ptaszek, fajka) do skopiowania' — so the page matches both the descriptive query and the colloquial one. Use 'ptaszek'/'fajka' freely in body copy and FAQ headings; never use them as the *only* name, because a reader arriving from a formal context may not recognise them.
phrases.good_example: Znak zaznaczenia ✓ — potocznie nazywany fajką lub ptaszkiem — skopiujesz jednym kliknięciem.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 'fajka' alone in accessibility, legal or technical copy (it is ambiguous with the smoking-pipe meaning and with 'fajka' = SCUBA snorkel). Do not use 'parafka' outside a document-signing/office context — it specifically means an initialling mark, not a generic tick. Do not translate it into another Slavic locale's page without evidence.

phrases.english_concept: text-built face emoticon — the everyday Polish word
phrases.usage_guidance: Good as the human-facing noun on a Polish text-faces page ('Buźki do skopiowania'). Pair with 'emotikony' in the meta/first paragraph so the more technical query is also served.
phrases.good_example: Buźki z klawiatury do skopiowania — ponad 500 emotikonów tekstowych ( ˘ ³˘)
phrases.avoid_when: Too soft for competitive-gaming nickname copy (there PL-006 'ksywka' register applies). Avoid in technical Unicode explanations and in anything legal/accessibility-flavoured.

phrases.native_phrase: emotikony (znaki z klawiatury) vs emoji (piktogramy) vs emotki (potocznie na wszystko)
phrases.english_concept: the emotikon / emoji / emotka three-way lexical split
phrases.register: neutral; the distinction is explanatory, 'emotki' is casual
phrases.usage_guidance: Polish pages on this surface should USE the distinction rather than paper over it: lead with 'emotikony to znaki z klawiatury' to establish that the output is pure text and works everywhere. This is exactly the differentiator the product has, and Polish already has the vocabulary to state it — a machine translation would flatten all three into 'emoji' and lose the point.
phrases.good_example: Emotikony to znaki z klawiatury, np. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ — w odróżnieniu od emoji, które są graficznymi piktogramami i mogą wyglądać inaczej na każdym telefonie.
phrases.avoid_when: Don't over-teach it in a purely transactional tool page — one sentence, not a section. Don't use 'emotki' in a title/H1: it's the sloppy catch-all and undercuts the precision you're selling.

phrases.english_concept: ASCII art, and its Polish technical name
phrases.usage_guidance: Title on 'ASCII art' — it's the Polish query form too. Use 'semigrafika' once in the body if the page explains the technique; it signals real subject knowledge that a translated competitor page won't have. Add 'rysunki ze znaków' as the plain-language description.
phrases.good_example: ASCII-Art (nazywany też semigrafiką) to sposób tworzenia rysunków wyłącznie ze znaków z klawiatury.
phrases.avoid_when: Don't lead with 'semigrafika' — near-zero search demand, reads as a textbook. Don't use it for single face emoticons.

phrases.usage_guidance: Boundary use only, on ASCII-art / big-text pages: mass-pasting reads as a 'pasta' and gets muted. Do not adopt the word into product framing.
phrases.good_example: Wklejanie tego samego rysunku kilka razy pod rząd jest odbierane jak pasta i na większości serwerów kończy się mutem.
phrases.avoid_when: Never in a title, meta, CTA, or anywhere near education/printables copy. The Polish 'pasta' genre carries a vulgarity association that must not attach to the brand.

phrases.english_concept: 'typeface' in the professional register vs. the colloquial word for font
phrases.register: krój pisma = professional/typographic; czcionka = colloquial, universal
phrases.content_surface: body copy, faq — keep czcionka in h1/title
phrases.usage_guidance: Keep PL-001 (ładne czcionki do skopiowania) as the head term — 'czcionka' is what Poles type. Use 'krój pisma' once or twice in body copy about ceremonial typography to signal expertise, never as the page's target.
phrases.good_example: Wybierając fonty — czyli popularnie „czcionki" — nie stawiaj na wiele różnych i niepasujących do siebie krojów pisma.
phrases.avoid_when: Never on gaming/nickname pages — 'krój pisma' beside 'ksywka' (PL-006) or 'odpicować nick' (PL-007) is a register collision. Also do not correct a reader's 'czcionka' to 'krój pisma' in user-facing copy; it reads as pedantry.

phrases.english_concept: the couple and the wedding stationery suite
phrases.register: neutral-respectful; the capitalisation is part of the convention
phrases.usage_guidance: Use 'Imiona Pary Młodej' as the label for a ceremonial name example. Keep the capitalisation — lowercase 'para młoda' in wedding copy reads as careless to a Polish reader.
phrases.good_example: Imiona Pary Młodej zdecydowanie powinny być widoczne i przykuwać uwagę.
phrases.avoid_when: Never on gaming/nickname pages. Note it means the couple specifically on and around the wedding day — for a general romantic-nickname context it is wrong, and Polish would use something else entirely.

phrases.english_concept: the line-break action that produces stacked text in a bio/caption
phrases.register: casual/community; the voice of an influencer answering DMs, not of documentation
phrases.content_surface: faq heading, body, tool copy — not h1
phrases.usage_guidance: Use «entery» in FAQ/body copy where the casual register fits, and «nowy akapit» in the heading if the page needs a neutral, searchable form. Do not put «entery» in quotation marks in our own copy the way the source does — quoting it signals the writer is not part of the community; using it plainly signals they are.
phrases.good_example: Jak zrobić entery w bio na Instagramie i pisać od nowej linijki.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use «entery» in formal, legal, accessibility or technical copy — it is slang. Do not use it for a one-letter-per-line decorative effect; it names the line-break action only.

phrases.native_phrase: Instagram zlewa cały tekst w jeden akapit
phrases.english_concept: the platform merging the stacked lines back into one block
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the Polish FAQ heading for the collapsed-formatting question and answer it with the reliable method (draft in a notes app, or use an invisible character — PL-004). Note the source's own honesty, which is worth mirroring: not every method works for everyone, and the notes-app route is the dependable one.
phrases.good_example: Instagram czasem zlewa tekst z powrotem w jeden akapit — dlatego najpewniejsza jest metoda z notatką.
phrases.avoid_when: Not a title/H1 term. Do not use it for glyph-level failures (boxes, unsupported characters) — this is formatting collapse, a different problem with a different fix.

phrases.usage_guidance: Label the PL counter's stat 'znaki ze spacjami' and offer a ÷1000 rate helper; 'zzs' is recognized industry shorthand.

phrases.native_phrase: napis na tatuaż / napisy na tatuaż
phrases.usage_guidance: Primary head term for the PL tattoo-lettering usecase page — already live; this record backs it with independent competitor evidence (Eldar Tattoo, tatuaze.us, tatuaze.net.pl, VEAN Tattoo all use this exact phrase) plus real Semrush volume.
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — mainstream, already live

phrases.usage_guidance: PL uses znaki ("signs") for the character-set head term — znaki specjalne 2,900/mo — but switches to symbole for themed collections (symbole kwiatów 1,000, symbole kart 720, symbole walut 390).
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use znaki for a themed decorative collection; Polish search takes symbole + genitive there.
